transition_bench.pusher_throttle_observed: Pusher motor M5 spools up linearly from 0% to 75% cruise throttle upon transition entry
transition_bench.notes: BENCH VERIFIED ONLY. Propellers were completely REMOVED from all 5 motors. Simulated 20 m/s dynamic pressure into Matek ASPD-4525 pitot using regulated pneumatic source. Pusher motor spooled up smoothly; VTOL motors held attitude control for 18.0s before cleanly spooling down. Commanding mode change back to QHOVER at t=12s verified immediate transition abort: pusher throttle was cut and VTOL motors spooled back to hover command within 0.8 seconds. CRITICAL: Aerodynamic transition stability, wing stall margins, and flight transition speeds remain FLIGHT_TEST_REQUIRED.
